channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Nor'easter Brings Flooding, Power Outages to NYC Area; One Dead
item.description: Tens of millions are in the storm's path, with flights, concerts and sporting events canceled.

item.title: UK police arrest several under explosives act near US air base
item.description: British police said Sunday morning that several people were arrested on suspicion of offenses under the explosives act near an air base.

item.title: Several arrested, bomb disposal deployed near air base used by US forces
item.description: The air base has been used by U.S. forces involved in targeting Iran since the war began in February.

item.title: Separate mass shootings in South Africa townships kill at least 27
item.description: Two separate mass shootings near South Africa's two largest cities killed at least 27 people.
